   28 int LookupMnem(MNEM_TAB *table, const char *string)
   29 {
   30 	while (table->mnem != NULL) {
   31 		if (string && strcmp(string, table->mnem) == 0)
   32 			return table->value;
   33 		table++;
   34 	}
   35 	return table->value;
   36 }
   37 
   38 const char *LookupMnemName(MNEM_TAB *table, const int value)
   39 {
   40 	while (table->mnem != NULL) {
   41 		if (table->value == value)
   42 			return table->mnem;
   43 		table++;
   44 	}
   45 	return ""; // not found
   46 }
